title: Reproducing Razouk and Deal 1979: interface state density against oxidation temperature, orientation and the end of the oxidation

sample.paper: “Experiments were carried out with (100) and (111) wafers, chemically polished on one side and etched on the other side.” “Crystal growth was by the Czochralski process.”
sample.ours: FAMILY: Si_Planar; ORIENTATION: Si100 | Si111; GROWTH: Cz (recorded)

sample.paper: “4-6 Ω-cm for n-type phosphorus-doped and 5-9 Ω-cm for p-type boron-doped”; Figures 7 and 8 average n and p, Figure 13 is n-type
sample.ours: DOPING: n_and_p_averaged | n_type_phosphorus (recorded; no program reads it)
sample.note: On Figure 8 n-type (100) is 40% above p-type at 1100 and 1200 °C; the program has no doping.

sample.paper: sulfuric-peroxide or hot sulfuric acid, aqua regia, 10:1 HF, isopropanol vapour
“no gettering processes were employed”; etch pits “under 400 maximum average/cm2”
1200–2200 Å overall; per orientation only at 800 and 1200 °C
sample.ours: grown by the history with the 1965 law
sample.note: Thickness at 900–1100 °C is interpolated by us.

sample.paper: Aluminium dots, 1 µm, 750 µm diameter, flash evaporated at 25 °C
